description: This file defines a conversational retrieval question-answering chain class, including methods for initialization and execution, utilizing various language models, retrievers, and memory components. It also includes utility functions for creating retriever chains, formatting documents, and managing chat history, as well as a custom BufferMemory class for chat message persistence.

classes.name: ConversationalRetrievalQAChain_Chains
classes.description: Implements a conversational retrieval question-answering chain with methods for initialization and running, integrating memory, moderation, and streaming capabilities.

classes.name: BufferMemory
classes.description: A custom memory class extending FlowiseMemory for managing chat messages with database persistence, supporting retrieval and chat history management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the answer chain with provided model, retriever, and prompt configurations.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the conversational QA chain with input question, managing moderation, streaming, and chat history.
